title: Armor Crafting
description: This mod makes crafting vanilla armor more difficult. It also adds a unique 'Chain Link' item used to craft chainmail armor.
body:
**Armor Crafting makes vanilla armor harder to obtain and adds a new crafting component, the Chain Link, to create chainmail armor using a new recipe.**

Features:

- New craftable item: Chain Link (crafted from iron nuggets).
- Chainmail armor is now crafted using Chain Links.
- All vanilla armor recipes have been rebalanced for a more challenging survival experience.

Fully compatible with NeoForge 1.21.1.

_New recipes for crafting armor: diamond armor, iron armor and golden armor_
![New recipe crafting armor: diamond armor, iron armor and golden armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96ddc46a1a6c3e41f608f93291f33f066e53b691_0.webp)

_Now you can create chainmail armor from chain link._
![Now you can create chainmail armor from chain link.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d517a1add01a0505aae5e1d7a8e2405012867912_0.webp)
